hotspots.title: JD Vance Endorsement Drama
hotspots.blurb: Donald Trump rebuffed JD Vance's expectation of a 2028 presidential endorsement, sparking fierce back‑and‑forth on the Republican bench. Vance’s calls to stop “whining” about rival ads and the launch of a joint whistleblower program added fuel to intra‑party tensions.
hotspots.affect: The clash pits Trump’s gatekeeping power against Vance’s ambition, generating polarized outrage and a sense of high stakes for the GOP’s future.

hotspots.title: Farm Relief & $5,000 Bonus Promises
hotspots.blurb: President Trump unveiled an $8 billion farm relief package and conditional $5,000 payments to voters, framing them as “goodies” for Republican victories. Farmers welcomed trade relief but demanded more aid, while critics decried the voter‑bribery angle.
hotspots.affect: The promise of direct cash to voters and large subsidies fuels moral panic about vote‑buying and energizes rural constituencies.

hotspots.title: Tariff Lawsuits on Canadian Goods
hotspots.blurb: A food importer and other businesses sued the Trump administration over a sweeping 50 % tariff on Canadian imports, accusing the president of overstepping authority. The legal pushback was covered across trade and business outlets.
hotspots.affect: High economic stakes and accusations of executive overreach create a heated debate among exporters and policy critics.

hotspots.title: Election Intervention Lawsuits Surge
hotspots.blurb: Democrats sued the Trump administration over a voter‑purge effort, while the administration sued California over ballot handling, and Texas redistricting faced unexpected competition. These moves signal a battle over election integrity.
hotspots.affect: Claims of voter suppression and ballot manipulation provoke intense partisan alarm and fears of election tampering.
